full.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing an autopsy view of an infant's chest cavity. The thoracic organs, including the lungs and heart, are exposed following the removal of the anterior chest wall. The lungs appear severely hypoplastic and underdeveloped, which is characteristic of Potter sequence or congenital diaphragmatic hernia-related pulmonary hypoplasia. The findings are indicative of severe neonatal respiratory compromise.

The specimen features multiple well-circumscribed lesions within the tissue. Based on the macroscopic appearance, these findings are most consistent with uterine leiomyomas, commonly known as fibroids.
